exposure: conservative management for Placenta Accreta Spectrum disorders (PAS)
outcome: major maternal morbidities (postpartum hemorrhage, disseminated intravascular coagulation, uterine rupture, hysterectomy)
neonatal outcomes (full-term birth rate, live birth rate)
cohort: The study included 40 PAS patients who underwent successful conservative treatment and intended future fertility, observed between January 2013 and March 2021.
finding: Conservative management for PAS does not compromise subsequent fertility, but it significantly increases risks in subsequent pregnancies, including high PAS recurrence rates, substantial postpartum hemorrhage, and increased incidence of composite adverse delivery outcomes.
followup_time: Up to approximately 10 years (from initial PAS management until March 2023)
